title: 片上網路路由器
summary: 以Flit、虛擬通道與可證明路由連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect flits, virtual channels and verifiable routing through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

stages.title: 拓撲與封包化
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「拓撲與封包化」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop topology and packetization through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 拓撲座標：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「拓撲座標」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for topology coordinates.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「拓撲座標」的資料、控制與時間關係。網格連線決定跳數與切割頻寬。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「繪製 4×4 網格並計最遠跳數。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for topology coordinates. Mesh links determine hops and bisection bandwidth. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Draw a 4×4 mesh and count farthest hops. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 繪製 4×4 網格並計最遠跳數。
steps.observationEn: Draw a 4×4 mesh and count farthest hops.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：增加虛擬通道即自動證明無死鎖。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: More virtual channels automatically prove deadlock freedom. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「拓撲座標」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「網格連線決定跳數與切割頻寬。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit topology coordinates two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 拓撲座標的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 網格連線決定跳數與切割頻寬。
knowledge.textEn: Mesh links determine hops and bisection bandwidth.

knowledge.title: 拓撲座標的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 繪製 4×4 網格並計最遠跳數。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Draw a 4×4 mesh and count farthest hops. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設 128-bit flit、1 GHz、每週期一 flit，單向鏈路原始速率=16 GB/s。64 B 封包不計標頭需四 flit；四跳每跳 2 cycles 的空載路由延遲 8 ns，序列化另計。
knowledge.textEn: A 128-bit link at 1 GHz with one flit/cycle has 16 GB/s raw one-way rate. A 64 B packet needs four payload flits. Four hops at 2 cycles/hop give 8 ns unloaded routing latency; serialization is additional.

quiz.question: 本步審查「拓撲座標」與整體「片上網路路由器」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing topology coordinates within network-on-chip routers, which statement or check is supported?
options: 網格連線決定跳數與切割頻寬。
增加虛擬通道即自動證明無死鎖。
鏈路峰值可直接當作全部端點吞吐。
optionsEn: Mesh links determine hops and bisection bandwidth.
More virtual channels automatically prove deadlock freedom.
Peak link rate equals total endpoint throughput.
quiz.explanation: 網格連線決定跳數與切割頻寬。 繪製 4×4 網格並計最遠跳數。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Mesh links determine hops and bisection bandwidth. Draw a 4×4 mesh and count farthest hops. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 拓撲座標：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「繪製 4×4 網格並計最遠跳數。」檢查「拓撲座標」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for topology coordinates using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「拓撲座標」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：繪製 4×4 網格並計最遠跳數。 核對「網格連線決定跳數與切割頻寬。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for topology coordinates and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Draw a 4×4 mesh and count farthest hops. Check the principle: Mesh links determine hops and bisection bandwidth. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 繪製 4×4 網格並計最遠跳數。
steps.observationEn: Draw a 4×4 mesh and count farthest hops.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：增加虛擬通道即自動證明無死鎖。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: More virtual channels automatically prove deadlock freedom. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「拓撲座標」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「繪製 4×4 網格並計最遠跳數。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit topology coordinates input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

steps.title: 端點介面：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「端點介面」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for endpoint interface.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「端點介面」的資料、控制與時間關係。端點需組包、拆包並保留語義。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對封包與原始請求對應。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for endpoint interface. Endpoints packetize and reassemble semantic messages. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Match packets to original requests. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 核對封包與原始請求對應。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：鏈路峰值可直接當作全部端點吞吐。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Peak link rate equals total endpoint throughput. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「端點介面」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「端點需組包、拆包並保留語義。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit endpoint interface two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

steps.title: 端點介面：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「核對封包與原始請求對應。」檢查「端點介面」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for endpoint interface using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「端點介面」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：核對封包與原始請求對應。 核對「端點需組包、拆包並保留語義。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for endpoint interface and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Match packets to original requests. Check the principle: Endpoints packetize and reassemble semantic messages. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 核對封包與原始請求對應。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：鏈路峰值可直接當作全部端點吞吐。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Peak link rate equals total endpoint throughput. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「端點介面」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「核對封包與原始請求對應。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit endpoint interface input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
